clauses.title: Provider-mutation exceptions remain exact in the AC-GRANT contract section

clauses.title: Run-scoped bounded publication grant
requires: Only the exact PR `autofix` mode token supplies a run-scoped publication grant
For each validated correction batch against one reviewed public head/gate result
The run-wide cap is five successful correction pushes
